purpose: Exploratory supervised diagnostic; not a new sampler or real-data research result
selection: Maximize validation balanced accuracy after the common validation-negative FPR threshold; retain the first grid value on ties; never use subgroup identities or test data
primary_contrast: clean/RF100: ugo_generation_filter_disabled minus ugo_k5, conditional on actual minority generation and counterfactual rare-seed ranking access
secondary_contrasts: count-matched ROS/weights versus their UGO targets
inference: Exploratory, primary contrast prespecified; secondary intervals unadjusted and descriptive. A new method requires a specific residual failure and fresh confirmation. Missing or inactive mechanisms cannot support causal seed-filter claims.
phases: mechanism: fitting data only, save all resampling traces and arrays
pilot: requires the complete matching mechanism phase; fit and select on F/V before constructing or evaluating T
group_access: Evaluator only. No practical resampler, classifier, threshold or capacity/neighborhood selector receives group identities.
data_rules: Independent stratified exact-count draws for F/V/T; no label flips. Overlap replaces the declared fraction of majority conditional draws with the minority conditional law. Training rows are never removed by UGO filtering.
